summary: Teucrium Commodity Trust filed an 8-K on September 24, 2026, reporting under Item 8.01 that outstanding shares of its series, the 7RCC Spot Bitcoin and Carbon Credit Futures ETF (BTCK, NYSE Arca), rose above the 50,000-share minimum via new creation orders. The sponsor, Teucrium Trading, LLC, had previously rejected redemptions that would push shares below the threshold; it has now stopped rejecting on that basis but may resume if shares fall back to 50,000. The filing is an operational ETF share-count and redemption-eligibility update, not a special situation transaction.
